title: Aasman Neela Kyun Hai?
topic: Rayleigh scattering: why the daytime sky is blue, why sunsets are red, and why space is black

payload.mechanism: air molecules are ~1000x smaller than a light wave, so they scatter short wavelengths far harder (I ~ 1/lambda^4)
payload.number: blue at 450 nm scatters about 5.9x more than red at 700 nm; at sunset the beam crosses about 38x more air
payload.consequence: the sky is blue from every direction, sunsets are red, and above the air the sky is black

retellTest: Neela rang laal se paanch point nau guna zyada bikharta hai, isliye aasman neela hai aur sunset laal.
notes: Decisions live here so later turns do not re-derive them.
